item.title: "Party Contaminated by Election Fraud Claims" – Calls for Resignation Erupt… Jang Dong-hyuk Holds His Ground (“부정선거에 당 오염” 사퇴론 분출…장동혁은 ‘버티기’)
item.description:
Within the People Power Party, demands are erupting one after another for party leader Jang Dong-hyuk and the leadership to resign en masse, taking responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections. However, Jang is showing signs of entrenchment, insisting that "nothing is more important right now than the shortage of ballot papers in South Korea," raising the prospect of escalating internal conflict. <<> Woo Jae-jun, a senior youth committee member of the People Power Party, said in an open statement during the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 11th, "I wish we would all resign," adding, "I hope we can open the way for the next leadership." He continued, "We should hold another national convention, and Chairman Jang should run again in a by-election to be re-evaluated. Only then can party members with grievances accept the outcome, and we can unite and move forward together." Woo is classified as a pro-Han Dong-hoon faction member. <<> Pro-leadership Supreme Council members immediately moved to shield Chairman Jang. Cho Gwang-han, a close aide to Jang and a Supreme Council member, directly struck back, saying, "Making such immature remarks publicly is extremely politically inexperienced," prompting Woo to retort, "Immature remarks, you say?" The atmosphere in the meeting froze instantly. Then, Kim Min-soo, a Supreme Council member aligned with Jang, seized the microphone and launched an offensive, saying, "You should discuss matters like that in closed-door meetings," and "Why would someone who has never properly attended a single closed-door meeting come here to champion not the party, but a personal faction?" <<> In response, Chairman Jang stated, "Right now, nothing is more important in South Korea than this shortage of ballot papers. Whether ruling or opposition, the political sphere must resolve this issue." He added, "If we shift focus to that issue (the call for leadership resignation), our party will ultimately become buried in internal strife." He said, "If you demand any choices from or want to open a path for the party leadership, the 110 lawmakers (of the People Power Party) must first provide an answer on how to resolve this situation." This made it clear that he had no intention of resigning. <<> Immediately after the chaotic Supreme Council meeting, members of the Alternative and Future, a group of reform-minded lawmakers within the party, also pressured Jang over his position. They urged him to resign, stating, "Chairman Jang's leadership has collapsed, and this is entirely the responsibility of Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership." They further argued, "Chairman Jang must not contaminate the infringement of the people's right to vote caused by the ballot paper shortage with 'election fraud conspiracy theories,'" and "We clearly oppose the nationwide re-election (that Chairman Jang advocates)." They demanded that new floor leader Jung Jeom-sik convene a general assembly of lawmakers to build consensus on Chairman Jang's position and the issue of the infringement of voting rights. <<> The calls for Jang's resignation align with internal concerns over election fraud theories. There are successive criticisms that he is using the ballot paper shortage as a shield to preserve his position while even jumping on the bandwagon of election fraud claims. A two-term lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh* that day, "It was only a matter of time before Chairman Jang stepped down anyway, but if he had only talked about the infringement of voting rights, it would have been difficult to immediately demand his resignation," adding, "By contaminating (the party) with election fraud conspiracy theories, he has dug his own grave. The demands for Chairman Jang to resign are inevitably going to intensify further." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (국민의힘에서 6·3 지방선거 패배의 책임을 지고 장동혁 대표 등 지도부가 총사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 잇달아 분출되고 있다. 그러나 장 대표는 “지금 대한민국에서 투표용지 부족 사태보다 중요한 것은 없다”며 버티기에 나서면서 당내 갈등이 고조될 조짐이다.)

item.title: Parliamentary Report on 'Ballot Shortage' National Audit Request... Negotiations on Investigation Period and Scope Begin (‘투표지 부족’ 국조요구서 본회의 보고…조사 기간·내용 협상 돌입)
item.description:
A request for a parliamentary investigation into the 'ballot shortage incident' that occurred during the June 3 local elections was reported to the National Assembly plenary session on the 11th. Negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties over the details of the investigation have also begun in earnest. (6·3 지방선거에서 벌어진 ‘투표용지 부족사태’를 다루는 국정조사 요구서가 11일 국회 본회의에 보고됐다. 국정조사의 세부 내용을 둘러싼 여야 협상도 본격화됐다.)

On this day, parliamentary investigation requests signed by lawmakers from both the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party were submitted and reported to the plenary session. Under the rules, once a parliamentary investigation request is submitted, the National Assembly Speaker must report it to the plenary session without delay. Following this, the Speaker will consult with both parties to form a special committee on the parliamentary investigation, prepare an investigation plan detailing the period, purpose, and scope of the investigation, and proceed with a plenary vote. (이날 국회 본회의에는 더불어민주당과 국민의힘 양당 소속 의원이 모두 이름을 올린 국정조사 요구서가 각각 제출돼 보고됐다. 국회의장은 국정조사요구서가 제출되면 지체없이 본회의에 보고하게 돼 있다. 국회의장은 이후 양당과 협의해 국정조사 특별위원회를 구성하고 조사기간과 목적, 조사 범위 등을 기재한 조사 계획서를 마련해 본회의 의결 절차를 거치게 된다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, during a meeting with floor leaders Park Chan-dae (Democratic Party) and Kweon Seong-dong (People Power Party), urged them to "swiftly form the special committee on the parliamentary investigation and process the investigation plan at next week's plenary session, actively working together to uncover the truth as soon as possible." After the closed-door meeting, Jang Hyun-joo, the Speaker's senior secretary for public communication and coordination, told reporters, "The Speaker proposed scheduling next week's plenary session to form the special committee on the parliamentary investigation and discuss the investigation plan, and both floor leaders agreed with this intention." (조정식 국회의장은 이날 한병도 민주당·정점식 국민의힘 원내대표와 회동한 자리에서 “신속하게 국정조사특별위원회를 구성하고 다음 주 본회의에서 국정조사계획서를 처리해 하루라도 빨리 진상규명에 나설 수 있도록 적극 힘을 모아달라”고 당부했다. 비공개 회동 이후 장현주 국회의장 공보소통수석은 기자들과 만나 “조 의장은 다음 주 본회의 일정을 잡아 국정조사 관련 특위도 구성하고 국정조사 계획서를 협의하자는 제안을 하셨고 양당 원내대표도 그 취지에 공감했다”고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party and the People Power Party have begun specific negotiations over the period and content of the parliamentary investigation. The Democratic Party plans to conduct negotiations with the goal of passing the investigation plan on the 18th. However, opinions differ on the scope of the investigation and the composition of the special committee. Both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party have claimed the chairmanship of the special committee. The Democratic Party insists that the special committee should be formed based on the proportion of seats in the National Assembly, while the People Power Party is pushing for an equal number of members from both parties. (민주당과 국민의힘은 국정조사 기간과 조사 내용 등을 둘러싼 구체적인 협상에 들어갔다. 민주당은 오는 18일 국정조사계획서 의결을 목표로 협상을 진행한다는 계획이다. 다만 조사 범위나 특위 구성에 입장이 엇갈린다. 민주당과 국민의힘 모두 특위 위원장을 맡겠다고 주장했다. 민주당은 국회 의석 비율에 따라 특위를 구성해야 한다는 입장이지만, 국민의힘은 여야 동수를 고집하고 있다.)

According to a National Indicator Survey (NBS) conducted from the 8th to the 10th by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on 1,001 men and women aged 18 and over nationwide, 85% of respondents said a parliamentary investigation was necessary regarding the ballot shortage at some polling stations. Only 11% said it was not necessary. (이날 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 8일부터 10일까지 전국 만 18세 이상 남녀 1001명을 대상으로 실시한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과, 일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해서는 응답자의 85%가 국정조사가 필요하다고 답했다. 필요하지 않다는 응답은 11%였다.)

Go Han-sol, Go Gyeong-ju reporters sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 고경주 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee at Korea-EU Summit: "Strongly Requested Favorable Consideration of Steel Duty-Free Quotas" (이 대통령, 한-EU 정상회담서 “철강 무관세 쿼터 우호적 고려 강력 요청”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung at the Korea-European Union (EU) summit held in Brussels, Belgium on the 10th (local time) "strongly requested favorable consideration for South Korea, an FTA signatory and strategic partner, in order to secure as many steel duty-free quotas as possible," the presidential office announced. <<> Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy office, said at a briefing held at a press center set up in Rome, Italy on the 11th, "Following the guidelines from the Korea-EU summit leaders, the trade chief and the EU conducted intensive negotiations on quota volumes, achieving maximum progress," adding, "A favorable outcome compared to other countries is expected." <<> The EU had previously announced plans starting next month to cut duty-free import quotas in half under the Tariff-Rate Quota (TRQ) system and impose a 50% tariff on imports exceeding the allocated volume. <<> President Lee addressed the EU's steel tariff imposition as a major agenda item in his summit meeting the previous day with António Costa, President of the European Council, and Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission. Director Kim stated, "These negotiations were challenging due to the very limited time before the new system takes effect on July 1, but it served as a good opportunity to raise the issue at the highest level." He added, "President Lee explained the importance of bilateral relations at the Korea-EU summit and requested attention to ensure Korean companies do not face unfair disadvantages on steel issues." <<> He further said, "We explained that this could have broad impacts on industrial cooperation and supply chain stability, and stressed that results befitting a mutually beneficial economic relationship should be reached." Director Kim reported that the EU side responded by saying, "As a country sharing common values and a partner nation, we will consider South Korea as favorably as possible." <<> Rome/Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 지난 10일(현지시각) 벨기에 브뤼셀에서 열린 한-유럽연합(EU) 정상회담에서 “철강 무관세 쿼터를 최대한 확보하기 위해 자유무역협정(FTA) 체결국이자 전략적 파트너인 한국에 대한 우호적 고려를 강력히 요청했다”고 청와대가 밝혔다.)

item.title: Government to explain record 624.6 billion won fine on Coupang to U.S. government (정부, 쿠팡 6246억 과징금 관련 “미국 정부에 설명할 것”)
item.description:
After the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) decided on the 11th to impose a fine of 624.681 billion won on Coupang for personal information leakage and infringement incidents, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it "plans to explain the relevant details to the U.S. government." As Coupang has mobilized its full lobbying power with the U.S. government and Congress to pressure the South Korean government, attention is focused on the U.S. government's reaction to the "largest-ever" fine. (11일 개인정보보호위원회(개인정보위)가 개인정보 유출 및 침해 사고를 일으킨 쿠팡에 과징금 6246억8100만원의 과징금 등을 부과하기로 결정한 것과 관련해, 외교부는 “미국 정부에 관련 내용을 설명할 계획”이라고 밝혔다. 쿠팡이 미 정부와 의회에 로비력을 총동원해 한국 정부를 압박했던만큼, ‘역대 최대 규모’의 과징금 처분에 대한 미 정부의 반응이 주목된다.)

A foreign ministry official, meeting with reporters on the same day, said, "The non-discrimination policy, including towards U.S. digital companies like Coupang, is also included in the joint fact sheet agreed upon by the South Korea-U.S. summit," and added, "We will calmly explain the results of the PIPC's measures regarding Coupang to the U.S. side while maintaining the non-discrimination policy." The official also stated, "It is understood that the PIPC conducted the investigation fairly in accordance with procedures set by domestic law, under the principle of imposing measures commensurate with responsibility, and gave Coupang sufficient opportunity to present its opinions during the investigation process." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is expected to explain the details and background of the PIPC's decision to the U.S. State Department. (외교부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “쿠팡을 포함한 미국 디지털 기업에 대한 비차별 정책과 관련한 내용이 한미 정상 합의사항인 조인트팩트시트(공동설명자료)에도 담겨 있다”며 “비차별 정책을 견지하면서 쿠팡에 대한 (개인정보위의) 처분 결과를 미국 쪽에 차분하게 설명할 것”이라고 말했다. 이 당국자는 “개인정보위가 책임에 상응하는 처분을 부과한다는 원칙 하에 국내법에서 정한 절차에 따라 공정하게 조사를 진행했고, 조사 과정에서 쿠팡이 충분히 의견을 개진할 수 있도록 기회를 부여한 것으로 안다”고 말했다. 외교부는 미 국무부에 개인정보위 결정의 내용과 배경을 설명할 것으로 보인다.)

Previously, on this day, the PIPC imposed a total fine of 624.681 billion won and a penalty of 16.8 million won on Coupang for reasons including leaking the personal information of 37.55 million members and non-members, and illegally collecting online activity records of approximately 1.17 million members without legal basis. (앞서, 개인정보위는 이날 쿠팡이 회원과 비회원 3755만명의 개인정보를 유출하고, 법적 근거 없이 회원 117만여명의 온라인 활동 기록을 무단으로 수집했다는 사유 등으로 모두 6246억8100만원의 과징금과 1680만원의 과태료를 부과했다.)

Under the Trump administration, the U.S. has increasingly tended to view regulations on its own digital companies as non-tariff trade barriers. Moreover, Coupang has been pressuring the South Korean government for months by mobilizing government officials and politicians through comprehensive lobbying of the White House, State Department, and Congress. Last January, when Prime Minister Kim Min-seok met U.S. Vice President JD Vance in Washington, Vice President Vance even directly mentioned the Coupang issue. (미국은 트럼프 행정부에 들어 자국 디지털 기업에 대한 규제를 비관세 무역 장벽으로 보는 경향이 더 커졌다. 게다가 쿠팡은 백악관과 국무부, 의회에 대한 전방위적 로비로 정부 관료와 정치인들을 움직여 수개월간 한국 정부에 압박을 가해왔다. 지난 1월 김민석 국무총리가 워싱턴에서 제이디 밴스 미국 부통령을 만났을 때 밴스 부통령이 쿠팡 문제를 직접 언급할 정도였다.)

It has been pointed out that U.S. dissatisfaction with the Coupang issue contributed to delays in tariff negotiations, as well as security negotiations on nuclear power and nuclear-powered submarines, at the beginning of the year for several months. South Korea and the U.S. rekindled discussions during their first security negotiations on the 2nd and 3rd, building a consensus to carefully manage external factors like the Coupang issue so they do not hinder negotiations. (관세협상 과정은 물론, 원자력·핵추진잠수함 등 안보협상이 연초부터 수개월간 지연된 데에도 쿠팡 문제에 대한 미국의 불만이 작용했다는 지적도 나왔다. 한-미는 지난 2∼3일 첫 안보협상을 하며 논의의 불씨를 살렸고, 쿠팡 문제와 같은 외부 요인이 협상에 지장을 주지 않도록 잘 관리해 나가자는 공감대도 쌓은 상황이다.)

However, given the unpredictable nature of the Trump administration and the reactions of U.S. lawmakers who have dealt with the Coupang issue, there is a high possibility of renewed pressure following this fine. On the same day, the U.S. global digital news platform 'Semafor' reported in an article titled "Trump allies stoke conflict over Coupang in South Korea" that Republican figures are stepping in to defend Coupang. Citing a source familiar with the Coupang matter, the outlet also reported, "USTR Representative Jamieson Greer is personally working to find a way to address Coupang's concerns." It also reported that as Coupang began utilizing a network of pro-Trump MAGA lobbyists, voices calling to support Coupang in the U.S. have grown louder. (하지만 불확실성이 큰 트럼프 행정부의 특성과 그간 쿠팡 문제를 다뤄온 미 의원들의 반응 등을 고려하면, 이번 과징금 부과를 계기로 다시 압박을 이어갈 가능성이 크다. 미국 글로벌 디지털 뉴스플랫폼 ‘세마포’는 이날 “트럼프 쪽 인사들이 쿠팡과 한국의 갈등에 불을 지핀다”는 제목의 기사에서 미 공화당 인사들이 쿠팡을 방어하기 위해 나서고 있다고 보도했다. 이 매체는 쿠팡 사안에 정통하다는 관계자를 인용해 “제이미슨 그리어 미국 무역대표부(USTR) 대표가 쿠팡의 우려를 해결할 방안을 마련하기 위해 직접 노력하고 있다”고도 전했다. 또, 쿠팡이 ‘친트럼프 마가(MAGA)’ 성향의 로비스트 네트워크를 활용하기 시작하면서 미국에서 쿠팡을 돕자는 목소리가 커졌다고 보도했다.)

By Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Korean LNG Ship Bound for Pakistan Passes Through Strait of Hormuz (파키스탄행 한국 LNG선, 호르무즈해협 통과)
item.description:
Amid continued U.S. airstrikes on Iran even during ceasefire negotiations, a Korean vessel that had been stranded in the Strait of Hormuz escaped the strait on the 11th. This is the second Korean ship to pass through the Strait of Hormuz since the outbreak of the U.S.-Israel-Iran war, following the HMM Universal Winner last month. (휴전 협상 중에도 이란에 대한 미국의 공습이 계속되는 가운데, 호르무즈해협에 발이 묶였던 한국 선박 1척이 11일 해협을 빠져나왔다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 발발 뒤 한국 선박이 호르무즈해협을 통과한 건 지난달 에이치엠엠(HMM) 유니버설 위너호에 이어 두번째다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the same day, “A Korean ship is currently navigating through the Strait of Hormuz,” adding, “Discussions regarding this passage were led by the foreign charterer, and we understand the ship is heading to a third country, its final destination.” A charterer refers to a company that leases a vessel from its owner. The charterer that led the negotiations with the Iranian government is reported to be QatarEnergy, and the ship’s final destination is Pakistan. (외교부는 이날 “한국 선박 1척이 호르무즈해협을 통과해 항행 중”이라며 “이번 통항 관련 협의 등의 사항은 타국적 용선사 쪽에서 주도해 이뤄졌으며, 이 선박은 최종 목적지인 제3국으로 향하고 있는 것으로 알고 있다”고 밝혔다. 용선사는 선주에게 배를 빌려 사용하는 회사를 뜻한다. 이란 정부와 협의를 주도한 용선사는 ‘카타르에너지’이며, 선박의 최종 목적지는 파키스탄인 것으로 전해졌다.)

The vessel in question is a liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier operated by a Korean shipping company and had been stranded while transporting natural gas to Pakistan. It is known to have eight Korean crew members on board. Pakistan, a country that has closely communicated with Iran and attempted mediation during this Middle Eastern conflict, appears to have facilitated the safe release of the ship based on its relationship with Iran. QatarEnergy is also continuously moving LNG carriers after consulting with Iran. (해당 선박은 한국 선사가 운용하는 액화천연가스(LNG) 운반선으로, 파키스탄에 천연가스를 운송하는 과정에서 발이 묶인 상태였다. 한국인 선원은 8명이 타고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 파키스탄은 이번 중동 전쟁에서 이란과 긴밀하게 소통하며 중재를 시도했던 국가로, 이란과의 관계를 바탕으로 선박을 안전하게 빼낼 수 있던 것으로 보인다. 카타르에너지 또한 이란과 협의를 거쳐 지속적으로 액화천연가스 운반선들을 이동시키고 있다.)

This marks the first Korean ship to pass through the Strait of Hormuz in about 20 days since the Universal Winner departed on the 20th of last month following consultations between the Korean government and the Iranian government. The Universal Winner, carrying 2 million barrels of crude oil, arrived at Ulsan Port the day before. (한국 선박이 호르무즈해협을 통과한 건 우리 정부가 이란 정부와 협의해 지난달 20일 유니버설 위너호가 빠져나온 지 20여일 만이다. 원유 200만배럴을 실은 유니버설 위너호는 전날 울산항에 도착했다.)

The number of Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz has decreased to 24. The total number of Korean crew members in the strait, including those aboard foreign vessels, stands at 139. It remains unclear when the remaining ships might be able to exit the strait. As ceasefire negotiations stall, U.S. airstrikes near the strait have continued for a second day, and Iran declared a closure of the Strait of Hormuz on the same day. Although the Korean government is in communication with the Iranian government, there has reportedly been no progress regarding the passage of the ships. (호르무즈해협에 발이 묶인 한국 선박은 24척으로 줄었다. 해협 내 한국인 선원은 외국 선박에 승선 중인 인원을 포함해 모두 139명이다. 남은 선박이 언제쯤 해협을 빠져나올 수 있을지는 현재로선 불투명하다. 휴전 협상이 공전하면서 해협 인근을 향한 미국의 공습이 이틀째 계속되고, 이란은 이날 호르무즈해협 폐쇄를 선언했다. 우리 정부는 이란 정부와 소통하고는 있지만, 선박 통항과 관련한 진척은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: South Korea and US Confirm "Shared Goal of North Korean Denuclearization"... 6th Nuclear Consultative Group Meeting (한미 “북한 비핵화 공동목표 확인”…6차 핵협의그룹 회의)
item.description:
South Korea and the United States held the 6th ROK-U.S. Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG) meeting on the 11th to reaffirm the goal of North Korean denuclearization and signed the NCG's security guidelines. (한미 양국이 11일 제6차 한미 핵협의그룹(NCG) 회의를 열어 북한 비핵화 목표를 재확인하고, 핵협의그룹의 보안지침에 서명했다.)

In a joint press statement released after the NCG meeting at the Ministry of National Defense in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, the two countries' defense ministries specified "North Korean denuclearization" as a shared goal. The statement said, "We decided to continuously develop NCG activities to strengthen the ROK-U.S. alliance and extended deterrence in a changing security environment where North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities are advancing," adding, "South Korea and the US confirmed a shared goal of North Korea's denuclearization." The joint statement from the 5th meeting, which was the first held under the Lee Jae-myung administration, did not include the phrase "North Korea's denuclearization," but it was included this time. The two countries further stated, "The US side reaffirmed its commitment to provide extended deterrence to the Republic of Korea by utilizing all categories of US capabilities, including nuclear capabilities." (양국 국방부는 이날 서울 용산구 국방부에서 핵협의그룹 회의 뒤 발표한 공동언론성명에서 ‘북한 비핵화’를 공동 목표로 명시했다. 성명은 “북한의 핵·미사일 능력이 고도화되고, 변화하는 안보환경 속에서 한미동맹 및 확장억제를 강화하기 위해 한미 핵협의그룹 활동을 지속적으로 발전시켜 나가기로 했다”며 “한미는 북한의 비핵화에 대한 공동의 목표를 확인했다”고 밝혔다. 이재명 정부 들어 처음 열렸던 지난 5차 회의 공동성명엔 “북한의 비핵화” 표현이 없었는데, 이번에 포함된 것이다. 양국은 이어 “미국 쪽은 핵을 포함한 미국의 모든 범주의 능력을 활용하여 대한민국에 확장억제를 제공하는 공약을 재확인했다”고 덧붙였다.)

The meeting was co-chaired by Kim Hong-cheol, Director General for Defense Policy at the Ministry of National Defense, and Robert Soofer, Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, Biological, and WMD Policy and Programs at the US Department of Defense, with officials from the defense, foreign affairs, and intelligence agencies of both countries in attendance. The meeting took place about six months after the 5th meeting was held in December last year. (회의는 김홍철 국방부 국방정책실장과 로버트 수퍼 미 전쟁부(국방부) 핵억제·화생방 정책 및 프로그램(WMD) 대응정책 부차관보 공동 주관으로 진행됐고 양국 국방·외교·정보 관계관들이 배석했다. 회의는 지난해 12월 5차 회의가 열린 뒤 6개월여 만에 열렸다.)

At this meeting, South Korea and the US also signed the "ROK-U.S. Nuclear Consultative Group Security Guidelines" to protect information needed for NCG activities and consultations. They reviewed tasks for the NCG, including such security and information sharing, consultation procedures in nuclear crises, integrated ROK-U.S. nuclear and conventional (CNI) exercises and training, strategic messaging, and risk reduction, and discussed various measures to strengthen the alliance's nuclear deterrence and readiness posture. (한미는 이번 회의에서 핵협의그룹 활동과 협의에 필요한 정보보호를 위한 ‘한미 핵협의그룹 보안지침’에도 서명했다. 이러한 보안과 정보공유, 핵위기 시 협의 절차, 한미 핵·재래식 통합(CNI) 연습과 훈련, 전략적 메시지 및 위험감소 등 핵협의그룹 추진 과업을 검토하고, 동맹의 핵억제와 대비 태세를 강화하기 위한 다양한 방안도 논의했다.)

ROK-U.S. nuclear and conventional integration is a concept where the US leads nuclear operations and South Korea supports them with conventional forces. At the 5th meeting, the two countries specified for the first time that "South Korea will play a leading role in conventional defense on the Korean Peninsula." The representatives of both sides agreed to report the results of this meeting to the ministers of the two countries at the 58th ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM). They also approved the NCG's tasks and major activities for the latter half of this year, including plans to hold the 7th NCG plenary meeting. (한미 핵·재래식 통합은 미국이 핵작전을 주도하면 한국이 재래식 전력으로 이를 지원하는 개념이다. 지난 5차 회의에서 양국은 처음으로 “한국이 한반도 재래식 방위에 대한 주도적 역할을 수행해 나갈 것”이라고 명시했다. 한미 양쪽 대표는 이번 회의 결과를 제58차 한미안보협의회(SCM)에서 양국 장관에게 보고하기로 합의했다. 또 제7차 핵협의그룹 본회의 개최계획을 포함한 올해 후반기 핵협의그룹 추진과업과 주요활동을 승인했다.)

item.title: President Lee Mourns Former Speaker Kono... "Kono Statement, Cornerstone of Korea-Japan Relations" (이 대통령, 고노 전 의장 애도…“고노 담화, 한일관계 주춧돌”)
item.description:
While on a state visit to Italy, President Lee Jae-myung expressed on the 11th (local time) regarding the passing of former House of Representatives Speaker Yohei Kono, who served as president of the Liberal Democratic Party, "I respectfully pray for the repose of the deceased and offer my deepest condolences to the bereaved family." (이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 11일(현지시각) 자민당 총재를 역임한 고노 요헤이 전 중의원 의장이 별세한 데 대해 “삼가 고인의 명복을 빌며, 유가족 여러분들께도 깊은 위로의 말씀을 전한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stated on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "Former Speaker Kono, as a respected elder of Japanese politics, worked to build reconciliation and trust with neighboring countries and played a significant role in the development of Korea-Japan relations." He continued, "In particular, the 'Kono Statement' issued in 1993 was the first official document to acknowledge the historical fact that left 'deep wounds to the honor and dignity of many women' regarding the comfort women issue and to explicitly state 'heartfelt apologies and remorse.' At that time, through the Kono Statement, it also expressed the will to not turn away from historical facts but to face them as lessons and never repeat the same mistakes." <<> President Lee said, "The courage to reflect on history and the empathy for the pain of victims contained in the Kono Statement have become an important cornerstone for the development of a future-oriented relationship between Korea and Japan." He added, "While cherishing the achievements and noble intentions left by the deceased, I will continue to strive to develop a future-oriented Korea-Japan relationship based on mutual respect and trust." <<> Former Speaker Kono passed away the previous day at the age of 89. He was first elected in the 1967 House of Representatives election as a member of the Liberal Democratic Party, inheriting his father's constituency, and was subsequently re-elected 14 times consecutively. In 2003, he became Speaker of the House of Representatives and served for five and a half years before retiring without running in the 2009 election. <<> Rome/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “고노 전 의장님은 일본 정계의 존경받는 원로로서 이웃 국가들과의 화해와 신뢰 관계 구축에 힘쓰며 한일관계의 발전에도 큰 역할을 하셨다”며 “특히 1993년 발표한 ‘고노 담화’는 위안부 문제와 관련하여 ‘많은 여성들의 명예와 존엄에 깊은 상처’를 남긴 역사적 사실을 인정하고, ‘마음에서 우러나오는 사죄와 반성의 마음’을 명기한 최초의 공식 문서였다”고 말했다. 당시 고노담화를 통해 역사의 사실을 외면하지 않고 교훈으로 직시해 나가겠으며, 같은 잘못을 결코 되풀이하지 않겠다는 의지도 표명했다.)

item.title: Aftermath of Local Elections…Will Jeong Cheong-rae Enter the August Party Convention? [Gongdeok Pocha] (지방선거 후폭풍…정청래, 8월 전당대회 나갈까?[공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

The dispute over responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections is escalating into conflict within the Democratic Party ahead of the August party convention. <<> On the morning of the 11th, during a closed-door general meeting of lawmakers, demands for Representative Jeong Cheong-rae to step down erupted. Lawmakers including Jang Cheol-min and Im Mi-ae argued that there was no party-level reflection even after the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, and that Representative Jeong must immediately resign to ensure neutrality and fair management if he intends to seek re-election. The previous day, at the Supreme Council meeting, Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon announced he would not run, pressuring Representative Jeong, while lawmaker Park Ji-won called for the entire leadership to resign. <<> Amid this pressure, Representative Jeong stated, "Public sentiment is the will of heaven," and "No regime can defeat the people," publicly rebuking President Lee Jae-myung and signaling his will to fight head-on. <<> However, public sentiment is not favorable. According to the National Indicator Survey (NBS) released on the same day by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research, 45% of respondents said the opposition "performed well" in the local elections, surpassing the 31% who said the ruling camp "performed well." <<> President Lee's approval rating for state affairs also dropped to 57%, down 9 percentage points from three weeks ago (66%), while party support rates showed the Democratic Party falling 4 points to 41% and the People Power Party rising 5 points to 25%, narrowing the gap. This survey was conducted from the 8th to the 10th with 1,001 people aged 18 and older. For more details, visit the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee. <<> Amid the heated blame game over the local elections, will Representative Jeong Cheong-rae run for the August party convention? Can President Lee Jae-myung boost his shaken approval ratings? The People Power Party's floor leader primary ended in an unexpectedly tight race, with Representative Jeong Jeom-sik winning by just 7 votes after a runoff—what does this mean?
